title: The Budget of 28 October 2026 and the OBR's forecast for it
intro: The OBR's October forecast is your baseline, with the Chancellor's measures already in it. Two days on, nothing has moved it.

source.quote: the average margin (around £29 billion) that previous Chancellors have left themselves against meeting their fiscal mandates
source.note: Paragraph 7.11 (p. 165) dates the record: the margin "that previous Chancellors have left against their fiscal mandate since 2010". The October 2026 EFO keeps the figure, paragraph 1.26: "below the average margin of close to £30 billion held by Chancellors since 2010".

source.quote: This increase in the NFR will be financed by gilt sales of £250.6 billion
source.note: The net financing requirement rose to £258.6 billion at the Budget, £7.4 billion more than at the April revision; gilt sales meet £250.6 billion of it (£4.4 billion more than planned in April) and Treasury bills £8.0 billion.
